types.name: chain.zipper.v1.AssetChainVariant
types.doc:
AssetChainVariant describes one chain route that can be used to deposit into
 or withdraw from a unified Polyester asset.

fields.name: zipped_asset_id
fields.doc: Canonical zipped asset route id.

fields.name: chain_id
fields.doc: Chain that this asset belongs to.

fields.name: is_native_asset
fields.doc: True when the asset is the native gas/token of the source chain.

fields.name: network_fee
fields.doc:
Latest known network fee for this chain asset variant as a human-readable
 string in zToken units, with insignificant trailing zeroes trimmed.

fields.name: ztoken_address
fields.doc: Polyester zToken contract address for this chain asset variant.

fields.name: source_address
fields.doc: Source-chain token contract, mint, or native sentinel address.

fields.name: source_decimals
fields.doc: Source-chain token decimals.

fields.name: ztoken_decimals
fields.doc: zToken decimals on Polyester chain.

fields.name: deposit_min_amount
fields.doc: Minimum deposit amount for this variant as a human-readable string in zToken units.

fields.name: withdraw_min_amount
fields.doc: Minimum withdraw amount for this variant as a human-readable string in zToken units.

fields.name: supply_q
fields.doc:
Latest zToken supply for this chain asset variant, scaled by the parent
 unified asset's quantity_scale. Decode: supply_q / 10^quantity_scale.

types.name: chain.zipper.v1.AssetConfig
types.doc:
AssetConfig describes one unified Polyester asset and all compatible
 chain-specific variants supported by Zipper.

fields.name: asset
fields.doc: Unified Polyester asset code used inside Funding/Trading (for example: "USDT").

fields.name: ledger_id
fields.doc: Public unified asset id.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Human-friendly unified asset display name.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: Optional icon reference for the unified asset.

fields.name: quantity_scale
fields.doc:
Integer scale for unified-asset quantities (0..18). A scale of 8 means one
 whole asset is represented as 100000000 in supply_q and other
 quantity_scale-based fields.

fields.name: quantity_display_decimals
fields.doc: UI display precision for the unified asset.

fields.name: variants
fields.doc: Supported chain-specific deposit/withdraw variants for this unified asset.

fields.name: u_asset_id
fields.doc: On-chain uAsset id for the unified asset.

types.name: chain.zipper.v1.ChainConfig
types.doc: ChainConfig describes one supported external chain for deposit and withdraw.

fields.name: chain_id
fields.doc: PolyChain-registered chain id used across Zipper and lifecycle events.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable machine-friendly chain key (for example: "ethereum", "solana").

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Human-friendly display name.

fields.name: native_chain_id
fields.doc:
Native source-chain network identifier when useful for wallet or explorer
 integrations. For EVM chains this is the EIP-155 chain id; non-EVM chains
 may omit this and should be identified by `chain_id` and `code`.

fields.name: native_currency_symbol
fields.doc: Native gas token symbol for this chain (for example: ETH, BTC, SOL).

fields.name: explorer_url
fields.doc: Optional block explorer base URL for links.

fields.name: icon
fields.doc: Optional icon reference for UI display.

fields.name: required_confirmations
fields.doc: Default required source-chain confirmations when known.

fields.name: confirmation_time_seconds
fields.doc: Estimated average confirmation time in seconds when known.

fields.name: is_case_sensitive
fields.doc: True when source-chain addresses must preserve letter case.

fields.name: min_address_length
fields.doc: Inclusive minimum source-chain address length for validation.

fields.name: max_address_length
fields.doc: Inclusive maximum source-chain address length for validation.

types.name: chain.zipper.v1.ChainContractConfig
types.doc:
ChainContractConfig describes an active Polyester-chain contract address
 clients may need for supported deposit and withdraw flows.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Stable contract key for client lookups.

fields.name: address
fields.doc: EVM contract address on Polyester chain.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: Optional product-facing contract category, when known.

fields.name: description
fields.doc: Optional human-readable description.

fields.name: version
fields.doc:
Active contract version for this name. Versions increase when the address
 changes, allowing clients to identify the exact contract revision in use.

fields.name: chains
fields.doc: Supported chains ordered by chain code.

fields.name: assets
fields.doc: Supported unified assets ordered by asset code, each with compatible chain routes.

fields.name: ts_sec
fields.doc: Snapshot generation timestamp (seconds since epoch, UTC).

fields.name: polyester_chain_id
fields.doc: Polyester chain id used by all zToken addresses in `assets.variants`.

fields.name: contracts
fields.doc: Active Polyester-chain contracts ordered by contract name.

types.name: chain.zipper.v1.ZippedAssetSupplyBatch
types.doc: ZippedAssetSupplyBatch batches public zipped-asset supply updates.

fields.name: updates
fields.doc: Supply updates included in this batch.

types.name: chain.zipper.v1.ZippedAssetSupplyUpdate
types.doc:
ZippedAssetSupplyUpdate carries the latest route liquidity for one zipped
 asset. It is published on the Protobuf WebSocket channel.

fields.name: zipped_asset_id
fields.doc: Canonical zipped asset route ID.

fields.name: supply_q
fields.doc:
Latest zToken supply for this route, scaled by the parent asset's
 quantity_scale. Decode: supply_q / 10^quantity_scale.

types.name: chain.zipper.v1.ZipperReasonCode
types.doc:
ZipperReasonCode identifies a specific Zipper request outcome. Numeric
 values are stable and may be used for client decisions, analytics, and
 support.

values.name: DEPOSIT_WAIT_EXPIRED
values.doc: Deposit confirmations were not reached before the wait expired.

values.name: DEPOSIT_AMOUNT_INVALID
values.doc: Deposit amount is invalid.

values.name: DEPOSIT_AMOUNT_BELOW_MINIMUM
values.doc: Deposit amount is below the configured minimum.

values.name: DEPOSIT_AMOUNT_NOT_ABOVE_FEE
values.doc: Deposit amount is not greater than the fee.

values.name: DEPOSIT_NET_AMOUNT_BELOW_MINIMUM
values.doc: Deposit amount after fees is below the configured minimum.

values.name: EVM_DEPOSIT_SOURCE_TX_INVALID
values.doc: EVM deposit source transaction hash is invalid.

values.name: EVM_DEPOSIT_SOURCE_TX_ZERO
values.doc: EVM deposit source transaction hash is zero.

values.name: EVM_DEPOSIT_SOURCE_TX_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: EVM deposit source transaction was not found.

values.name: EVM_DEPOSIT_SOURCE_TX_REVERTED
values.doc: EVM deposit source transaction reverted.

values.name: EVM_DEPOSIT_TRANSFER_MISMATCH
values.doc: EVM deposit transfer does not match the request.

values.name: UTXO_DEPOSIT_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH
values.doc: UTXO deposit transaction does not match the request.

values.name: BTC_DEPOSIT_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH
values.doc: Bitcoin deposit transaction does not match the request.

values.name: BCH_DEPOSIT_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH
values.doc: Bitcoin Cash deposit transaction does not match the request.

values.name: DOGE_DEPOSIT_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH
values.doc: Dogecoin deposit transaction does not match the request.

values.name: LTC_DEPOSIT_TRANSACTION_MISMATCH
values.doc: Litecoin deposit transaction does not match the request.

values.name: UTXO_DEPOSIT_SOURCE_IS_DEPOSIT_ADDRESS
values.doc: UTXO deposit source is a registered deposit address.

values.name: SOLANA_DEPOSIT_SIGNATURE_INVALID
values.doc: Solana deposit signature is invalid.

values.name: SOLANA_DEPOSIT_TRANSACTION_FAILED
values.doc: Solana deposit transaction failed.

values.name: SOLANA_DEPOSIT_TRANSFER_MISMATCH
values.doc: Solana deposit transfer does not match the request.

values.name: XRP_DEPOSIT_SOURCE_HASH_INDEX_INVALID
values.doc: XRP deposit source hash index is invalid.

values.name: XRP_DEPOSIT_SOURCE_ADDRESS_INVALID
values.doc: XRP deposit source address is invalid.

values.name: XRP_DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_INVALID
values.doc: XRP deposit address is invalid.

values.name: XRP_DEPOSIT_PAYMENT_MISMATCH
values.doc: XRP deposit payment does not match the request.

values.name: REJECTION_UNMAPPED
values.doc: The request was rejected without a more specific mapped reason.

values.name: WITHDRAWAL_AMOUNT_INVALID
values.doc: Withdrawal amount is invalid.

values.name: WITHDRAWAL_AMOUNT_BELOW_MINIMUM
values.doc: Withdrawal amount is below the configured minimum.

values.name: WITHDRAWAL_ASSET_INVALID
values.doc: Withdrawal asset address is invalid.

values.name: WITHDRAWAL_SENDER_INVALID
values.doc: Withdrawal sender account is invalid.

values.name: WITHDRAWAL_DESTINATION_INVALID
values.doc: Withdrawal destination address is invalid.

values.name: WITHDRAWAL_ASSET_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: Withdrawal asset is unavailable on the destination network.

values.name: EVM_WITHDRAWAL_DESTINATION_INVALID
values.doc: EVM withdrawal destination address is invalid.

values.name: BTC_WITHDRAWAL_DESTINATION_INVALID
values.doc: Bitcoin withdrawal destination address is invalid.

values.name: BCH_WITHDRAWAL_DESTINATION_INVALID
values.doc: Bitcoin Cash withdrawal destination address is invalid.

values.name: DOGE_WITHDRAWAL_DESTINATION_INVALID
values.doc: Dogecoin withdrawal destination address is invalid.

values.name: LTC_WITHDRAWAL_DESTINATION_INVALID
values.doc: Litecoin withdrawal destination address is invalid.

values.name: SOLANA_WITHDRAWAL_DESTINATION_INVALID
values.doc: Solana withdrawal destination address is invalid.

values.name: XRP_WITHDRAWAL_CLASSIC_ADDRESS_INVALID
values.doc: XRP withdrawal classic address is invalid.

values.name: XRP_WITHDRAWAL_DESTINATION_TAG_INVALID
values.doc: XRP withdrawal destination tag is invalid.

values.name: WITHDRAWAL_LIQUIDITY_INSUFFICIENT
values.doc: Available liquidity is insufficient for the withdrawal.

values.name: COMPLIANCE_HIGH_RISK_ADDRESS
values.doc: Request address was classified as high risk.

values.name: REQUEST_VERIFICATION_REJECTED
values.doc: Request verification was rejected without a more specific reason.

values.name: REJECTED
values.doc: Request processing completed with a rejected result.

values.name: ERROR_UNMAPPED
values.doc: Request processing failed with an unmapped error.

values.name: ERROR_NETWORK_UNSUPPORTED
values.doc: Selected network is unsupported.

values.name: ERROR_REQUEST_PROCESSING_FAILED
values.doc: Request processing failed.

values.name: ERROR_REQUEST_VERIFICATION_FAILED
values.doc: Request verification failed.

values.name: ERROR_RESULT_SUBMISSION_FAILED
values.doc: Request result submission failed.

values.name: ERROR_STATUS_UNKNOWN
values.doc: Request status could not be determined.

types.name: chain.zipper.v1.ZipperReasonDetails
types.doc: ZipperReasonDetails provides an exact Zipper reason and display metadata.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable code assigned to the specific outcome.

fields.name: reason_id
fields.doc: Stable reason identifier suitable for localization lookup.

fields.name: message
fields.doc: User-displayable English explanation of the outcome.
